_meta.title: Human reply that TALKS ABOUT a bounce — the NDR classifier's false-positive guard
_meta.covers: not in the §7.6 list; added because the classifier's harmful failure direction is a FALSE POSITIVE (a crafted reply that suppresses a real human's address = mail denial-of-service against a real recipient)
_meta.expect: 204; threaded as an ORDINARY reply (entity_type/entity_id populated); mail_log.status is UNCHANGED and NO suppression row is written. One NDR-ish signal (subject wording) is never enough — classification needs two, and the RFC 3464 report fields are the half a hand-written fake would have to forge wholesale.

items.RawTextBody: Heads up - Budi told me your approval mail came back as undeliverable for him. Status 5.1.1 apparently. Anyway, I approve the scope.
